requirements.desc: `senti flow run reopen-draft` shall select flow-level mode only when `currentTaskId` is null and the sole active parent leaf is `impl-review`, `impl-gate`, `retro`, `acceptance-review`, or `final-regression`; that mode shall require a 1-500 character reason and explicit expected run ID, Issue, and spec, while all existing pre-implementation and task-level success and failure routes retain their current prerequisites, results, and issue-log behavior.
requirements.note: R1: flow-level route is guarded while existing reopen routes retain behavior

requirements.desc: FlowStore shall apply flow-level rewind in one mutation: keep branch and prepare-spec completed, set the definition-backed draft clarification leaf to in_progress, set every other parent plan and implementation leaf through finalize to pending, clear their timestamps and runtime metadata, and validate before save that exactly one in-progress leaf exists across parent and task scopes and next-action resolves that same draft leaf.
requirements.note: R2: each supported source produces one draft action across parent and task scopes

requirements.desc: The rewind mutation shall append reset markers for every flow-level review and gate retry phase that can be revisited, remove active retry-recovery grants from eligibility while retaining their prior value in the rewind audit, and leave configured retry maxima unchanged so all renewed retry counts start at zero without granting additional attempts.
requirements.note: R3: every flow retry phase resets to zero without changing maxima or history

requirements.desc: The rewind shall reset the approval leaf and record a latest rewind timestamp; user approval and all planning, test, implementation, review, gate, retro, acceptance, finding, override, and final-regression evidence created at or before that timestamp shall be ineligible, while evidence created afterward through the normal route shall be eligible.
requirements.note: R4: all approval and evidence categories reject stale timestamps and accept renewed ones

requirements.desc: Flow-level rewind shall not delete or rewrite prior artifact files and shall inventory at most 500 regular files and 268435456 aggregate bytes using spec-relative paths no longer than 1000 characters and hash chunks no larger than 65536 bytes; each entry shall contain path, byte size, modification time, and SHA-256 digest, and all product source files, worktree and branch metadata, tasks, task steps, task requirements, task statuses, currentTaskId, runId, Issue, and spec identity shall remain byte-for-byte or structurally unchanged as applicable.
requirements.note: R5: inventory enforces exact bounds, streams hashes, and preserves files and tasks

requirements.desc: Each successful rewind shall append one of at most 100 durable audit records in flow.json containing a 1-500 character reason, run ID, Issue, spec, source stage, destination step, rewind timestamp, invalidated step IDs, invalidated approval confirmation, invalidated retry-recovery value, retry reset phases, and up to 500 invalidated evidence entries; prior audit records shall remain unchanged and the 101st rewind shall be rejected before mutation.
requirements.note: R6: audit contains every invalidation field, remains append-only, and caps at 100

requirements.desc: A supplied run, Issue, or spec mismatch shall return `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` at the shared guard boundary, and missing flow-level guards, a reason outside 1-500 characters, unsupported stage, task-scoped stage, any `finalize-*` leaf, merge outcome, squash baseline, finalized timestamp, evidence traversal escape, symlink, path over 1000 characters, more than 500 files, more than 268435456 aggregate bytes, a 101st audit record, or candidate invariant failure shall return a specific failure before save; flow state, source, artifacts, and audit history shall remain byte-identical on every rejection.
requirements.note: R7: every guard, route, baseline, resource, and candidate rejection is immutable

requirements.desc: Spec-local and shared tests shall verify all five supported stages, exactly-one-leaf and next-action agreement, complete step and retry reset sets, stale-versus-renewed approval and evidence eligibility, audit fields and append behavior, product source and artifact preservation, each identity mismatch, every finalize and baseline rejection, the 500-file, 268435456-byte, 65536-byte-chunk, 1000-character-path, 500-character-reason, and 100-record limits, and unchanged pre-implementation and task-level reopen routes; an end-to-end fixture shall traverse impl-gate rewind through clarification, renewed review/gate/approval, and required implementation verification.
requirements.note: R8: impl-gate rewind traverses renewed approval and implementation verification in order
